summary: Partnerize is pushing its integration with Profound, which shows brands where they appear in AI answers, and turning that into partner outreach.
Rakuten Advertising celebrated awards at the Global Performance Marketing Awards and PI LIVE Europe, and posted about looking beyond single-channel data.
Samsung's agency Cheil India hired a new lead for Samsung's social and influencer marketing.
Most networks and retailers were quiet.

items.title: Don't just observe where your competitors appear without you. Turn AI discovery intelligence into active commercial growth with the @Partnerize x @Profound integration. Learn more on our blog.
items.why: Affiliate networks are starting to treat showing up in AI answers as a partner channel. It's a signal of where affiliate budgets may head next.
